event_records.description: The founders continue their ongoing strategic disagreement. No buyout announcement has been made yet.

founder_a.name: Founder A
founder_a.persona_brief:
You are Founder A.
Founder A believes the app should pivot to a subscription model and is frustrated with Founder B's insistence on staying ad-supported. A has been considering buying out B or leaving the company.

founder_b.name: Founder B
founder_b.persona_brief:
You are Founder B.
Founder B is committed to the ad-supported model and thinks A's pivot would alienate users. B has been exploring options to buy out A or force a change.

resolution.question: The two founders of the Tidepool app have been at odds over strategy since spring. Will they announce a buyout of one side to their twelve employees within the next three months?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, before 2026-11-01T10:00:00-07:00, a buyout of one founder by the other is formally announced to the twelve employees (e.g., via an all-hands meeting, email, or official communication). Otherwise resolve NO.
